plan: With a private value of $35, I want to maximize potential profit. Since this is a single round with no prior history, I'll use a strategic bid slightly below my true value. Bidding exactly $35 risks losing money if others bid higher. A bid around $30-$32 gives me a buffer for potential profit while still having a good chance of winning. This strategy balances winning probability with potential earnings margin.

A bid near my value but not exactly at it gives me room for potential profit. I'll aim to bid slightly above the midpoint of my value, around $25-$28, which provides a reasonable chance of winning while preserving potential profit if I secure the item.
